title: Non Teaching Staff - Lady Irwin College, Delhi
summary: Non Teaching Staff - Lady Irwin College, Delhi: The page provides information for non‑teaching staff at Lady Irwin College, Delhi, including contact details, quick links for students, and operational hours. It lists the college’s address, phone number 014836, and indicates that the institution is part of the University of Delhi. The college holds an A+ NAAC accreditation and ranks 31 in the NIRF rankings. Admission enquiry is available from 9:30 am to 5:00 pm. The page also notes that the site is powered by WhiteCode and that all rights are reserved.
